verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a dedicated test-account environment (checkout.com/get-test-account) with sandbox testing docs covering payments, test cards, disputes testing, fraud-detection testing, bank payouts testing, and AVS/ANI checks, giving developers a mirrored sandbox with scenario-specific test cards including declines and disputes. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration that sandbox behavior fully mirrors production edge cases, and more detail on the breadth of decline-scenario coverage beyond doc titles.
